title: Can You Find Something Red?
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Apples, strawberries, and fire trucks. What color are they all?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Red! This is my friend Red.
An apple is red. A ball can be red. A heart is red, too!
Can you find something red around you? Point to it!
Red, red, red! Great job. See you in the lab!

title: Blue and Yellow Make Green!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: What happens when you mix blue paint and yellow paint? Let's find out!
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Blue, plus yellow, makes... green!
Leaves are green. Frogs are green. Trees are green!
Can you wiggle like a green frog? Ribbit!
Blue and yellow make green. See you in the lab!

title: How Many Sides Does a Triangle Have?
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: This shape is like a slice of pizza. How many sides does it have?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
It's a triangle! Let's count the corners. One, two, three!
A triangle has three sides and three corners.
A slice of pizza can look like a triangle!
Can you make a triangle with your fingers? See you in the lab!

title: Let's Count the Points on a Star!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Stars twinkle in the night sky. How many points does this star have?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
Let's count! One, two, three, four, five!
This star has five points.
Twinkle, twinkle! Stars shine in the sky at night.
Can you make your hands twinkle like stars? See you in the lab!

title: Bees Build With Hexagons!
sources: Early learning: colors, shapes and counting (preschool curriculum basics)

beats.say: Bees build their honeycomb with one special shape. Which shape is it?
Hi! I'm Bloop, the wobbly jelly blob. Welcome to my lab!
It's a hexagon! A hexagon has six sides.
Let's count the corners. One, two, three, four, five, six!
Honeycomb is made of lots of little hexagons, all fitting together.
Hexagon! Can you say it? See you in the lab!
